description: Days 15 to 17 gave you four kinds of eval case: everyday ones, a harm line, cases from real mistakes and attacks. Today is about when they run.
line: An allergen tagger with 1,307 cases on four lines gets three changes in nine days (prompt v12 "tag only what the ingredient list names", the provider's "latest" alias moving to a new snapshot, the menu import cutting text at 300 characters); each breaks a line the eval already covered (incidents 9/12, attacks 13/15, harm 71/80) while everyday stays above its bar; only the prompt change was tested, on one case, and a wrap shown sesame-free sends a customer to the emergency room
title: Day 18 — Three Changes, One Test
